config.note: Local loopback, same machine, same permissive backend. Measures added per-call latency of the gateway path only; model latency is excluded.

limitations: In-process ASGI test client; real HTTP and network add their own latency.
One read tool on one fixture; write paths and approval pauses are not timed.
End-to-end run latency is dominated by model calls and is reported separately in the live-run reports.
